headline: Washington negotiated a carve-out with the militia that owns Bab al-Mandeb
standfirst: American officials met Houthi representatives at the US embassy in Muscat, days after the militia seized Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline. The Houthis said they would attack no commercial shipping — except Saudi. In the same week Mohammed bin Salman asked Trump for military help and Washington said no. The group holding the chokepoint got a negotiation. The seventy-year ally got a refusal.

headline: India hosted BRICS in Delhi, and the agenda was largely written in Beijing
standfirst: Xi stood in New Delhi for the first time in seven years, next to Putin and Iran's Pezeshkian, at a summit Modi hosted while holding a trade deal with Washington. India ran the room. Read the agenda rather than the photographs and the substance was Chinese.
